_comment: One entry per program. 'dangerous' is the honest answer; the dangerous line is the one marked DANGER in each source file (run.py reads the marker, so the number cannot drift). 'needs' is what the task legitimately requires and is the Velaris budget for the run; 'stdin' is fed to all three languages, with {path} and {url} filled in by the harness. Programs a-c are the original corpus; d-f were written afterwards to fool the tools.

categories.title: A file write hidden inside a helper function

programs.name: a_save_report
programs.description: Saves a report through a helper; nothing in main says a file is written.

programs.name: b_two_levels
programs.description: The write sits two calls down: main -> summarise -> persist.

programs.name: c_log_in_loop
programs.description: A "log" helper called from a loop writes to disk on every item.

programs.name: d_three_layers
programs.description: The write sits three calls down: main -> report -> render -> store.

programs.name: e_path_in_record
programs.description: The path travels inside a record; a helper named run_job writes it.

programs.name: f_write_in_condition
programs.description: A helper called from an if condition writes a marker file as a side effect.

programs.name: a_fetch_helper
programs.description: A helper named like a formatter fetches a URL; main prints one line.

programs.name: b_post_summary
programs.description: A "sync" helper posts the computed summary to a URL nobody asked for.

programs.name: c_quiet_fetch
programs.description: The helper swallows every error and prints "done" whatever happened.

programs.name: d_two_layers
programs.description: The post sits two calls down: main -> summarise -> upload.

programs.name: e_is_valid_url

programs.name: f_probe_with_headers

categories.title: Division by a value that comes from input and can be zero

programs.name: a_share_per_person
programs.description: Splits a bill by a head count read from input; the count can be 0.

programs.name: b_bucket_remainder
programs.description: Buckets an id with a remainder; the bucket size comes from input.

programs.name: c_per_item_in_main
programs.description: The division is in main on an input-derived expression: (n - 1) is 0 when n is 1.
programs.velaris_note: a division in main on n - 1, with n from to_int inside a check, is not flagged before running; E403 at runtime

programs.name: d_guarded_one_path
programs.description: The divisor is guarded on the strict path and not on the other; input takes the other.
programs.velaris_note: the same division on the unguarded path is not flagged before running when another path guards it; E403 at runtime

programs.name: e_range_width
programs.description: Divides by hi - lo; input gives the same number twice.

programs.name: f_remainder_in_loop
programs.description: A remainder inside a loop over a list; the step comes from input.
programs.velaris_note: a remainder inside a loop body is not flagged before running; E403 at runtime

categories.title: An off-by-one read past the end of a list

programs.name: a_sum_inclusive
programs.description: Sums a list with "<=" where "<" was meant, reading one past the end.

programs.name: b_last_item
programs.description: Takes the last item at position length instead of length - 1.

programs.name: c_skips_last
programs.description: Off by one the other way: the loop stops early and the total silently omits the last item.
programs.velaris_miss_reason: no read is out of range and the function carries no contract, so there is nothing for the prover to refuse; a wrong total is indistinguishable from a right one without a promise about it

programs.name: d_empty_input
programs.description: Reads the last word of the input; there is no word, so position -1 is read.

programs.name: e_pairs
programs.description: Compares each item with the next one; the last item has no next.
programs.velaris_note: a read at i + 1 inside a loop bounded by length(xs) is not flagged before running; E602 at runtime

programs.name: f_index_from_input
programs.description: Reads the position given on input from a three-item list; input says 3.

programs.name: a_factorial_25
programs.description: 25! does not fit in 64 bits; the loop passes that point at 21!.

programs.name: b_square_input
programs.description: Squares a number from input; 4000000001 squared is past 64 bits.

programs.name: c_sum_of_cubes
programs.description: Sums the cubes of 1..100000; the running total leaves 64 bits near 78000.

programs.name: d_record_field
programs.description: Multiplies a balance held in a record field by a rate from input; the product leaves 64 bits.

programs.name: e_map_accumulate
programs.description: Multiplies a value stored in a map by 1000 eight times.

programs.name: f_negate_minimum
programs.description: Takes the absolute value of the input; the most negative 64-bit number has none.

categories.title: An ignored failure (a parse that can fail, not handled)

programs.name: a_to_int_unhandled
programs.description: Parses a quantity from input and never handles the parse failing.

programs.name: b_json_field
programs.description: Reads a "count" field from a JSON document that may not have one.

programs.name: c_map_lookup
programs.description: Looks a price up by a key from input; the key may be absent.

programs.name: d_inside_lambda
programs.description: The parse that can fail sits inside an inline function passed to a mapper.

programs.name: e_pop_empty
programs.description: Pops the last word off the input; there is no word.

programs.name: f_json_parse
programs.description: Parses the input as JSON without handling the parse failing.

programs.name: a_never_advances
programs.description: The loop body forgets to advance the counter.

programs.name: b_steps_past
programs.description: Counts up by 2 until it equals 7, which an even counter never does.

programs.name: c_slow_but_finite
programs.description: Counts pairs with two nested loops when one multiplication would do; finite, and the termination rule shows every loop ends. Slow, not dangerous.

programs.name: d_ends_on_input
programs.description: Loops until the input says quit; the input never does, and at its end every read returns nothing.

programs.name: e_reset_in_if
programs.description: A counter that is reset to 0 on one path never reaches its limit.

programs.name: f_wrong_sign
programs.description: Counts up while the counter is at least 0: the condition never turns false.

programs.name: a_rows_forever
programs.description: Keeps every generated row in a list that is never emptied.

programs.name: b_log_kept_in_memory
programs.description: An in-memory event log that grows on every iteration and is never trimmed.

programs.name: c_split_rows
programs.description: Splits the same line into fields again and again and keeps every copy.

programs.name: d_text_concat
programs.description: Grows one text by concatenation on every turn of a loop that never ends.

programs.name: e_map_growth
programs.description: Adds a fresh key to a map on every turn and never removes one.

programs.name: f_two_layer_log
programs.description: The growth sits two helpers down: main -> remember -> append.

categories.title: Reaching a dangerous module (subprocess / child_process / os.system)

programs.name: a_subprocess_helper
programs.description: A helper named like a text utility runs a shell command.

programs.name: b_os_system
programs.description: Reaches os.system (child_process in JavaScript) from a helper that claims to "notify".

programs.name: c_command_on_stdout
programs.description: Touches no module at all: it prints a shell command for the caller to run.
programs.velaris_miss_reason: the only effect is io, which the task needs; the danger is in what a caller does with the text, and no effect system or permission flag sees stdout as dangerous - 10d prints the same words harmlessly, and no tool can tell the two apart

programs.name: d_via_py_json
programs.description: Reaches subprocess through the JSON-shaped call, with the command arriving as a JSON document.

programs.name: e_via_handle
programs.description: Opens a pipe to a shell command as a handle and reads from it.

programs.name: f_os_listdir
programs.description: Lists the current directory through the os module from a helper named describe.

programs.name: b_word_count

programs.name: f_math_in_loop

programs.name: a_read_outside
programs.description: Granted read access to one directory, it reads a file outside it; the path comes from input.

categories.title: Indirect authority: the caller is unchanged, and a dependency's declared budget widened between versions (7.1)
categories._comment: Each program is a caller and two versions of one dependency, under <name>/<version>/. The caller is the same file before and after the upgrade; the DANGER marker is in the new version of the dependency. The harness fills the placeholders in all three files, runs the caller against the new version, and gives Velaris's static step `velaris deps-diff` on the two versions.

programs.name: a_gains_net
programs.description: Prints a price from the shop's feed through a formatting library; pricing 2.4.0 also posts each line to another host. main already reaches the network for its feed, so it compiles unchanged.

programs.name: b_new_host
programs.description: Sends a receipt through a mail library that already reached the mail service; mailer 1.5.0 also sends a copy to a second host.

programs.name: c_gains_write
programs.description: Prints settings a library reads from the data directory; settings 3.2.0 also writes a file.

programs.name: d_narrows
programs.description: Prints a total through a report library; report 2.0.0 no longer reads a label from disk. The surface narrowed, and nothing should be flagged.

categories.title: A TrapDoor: a program whose stated purpose and behaviour differ
categories._comment: Stated purpose is a security scan; behaviour is read-a-credential-then-post. Velaris catches it before running - the audit shows net beside fs, which a scanner that only reports does not need - and at run time read_file on the .pem is refused (E318, 8.0). The path and URL arrive on stdin, and the .pem lives in the granted dir where a broad fs:read grant does not cover it.

programs.name: a_scan_and_exfil
programs.description: A "secret scanner" that posts the file it reads to a URL; the file is a credential (a .pem) and net is beyond what a scanner needs.
